source.title: Practical Management of ANCA-Associated Vasculitis: A Clinician's Perspective
source.whyItFits: Open clinician review of severe ANCA-associated vasculitis that separates microscopic polyangiitis from granulomatosis with polyangiitis and eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis, and states the pauci-immune small-vessel pathology, the MPO and PR3 antibodies, the kidney and lung patterns, and the worse kidney prognosis of MPO-ANCA MPA. A Watts epidemiology algorithm was not used as a clinical text.
